projects.name: Simprove
projects.description: A golf performance tracking and training platform. Upload launch monitor data, track session stats, complete AI-recommended lesson plans, and earn badges as you improve.
projects.projectBio: A golf performance tracking and AI-powered training platform.
projects.projectIntro: Simprove is a golf performance platform built for players who want to train smarter. Upload your launch monitor data, track your ball flight metrics, complete structured lesson plans, and get AI-powered lesson recommendations tailored to your game after every session.
projects.projectPurpose: I built Simprove to combine my interest in golf with modern full-stack development. I wanted to build something production-grade that solved a real problem — golfers have access to a ton of data from launch monitors but no structured way to act on it. Simprove bridges that gap with a training system driven by real shot data and AI.
projects.projectBuild: Built with Next.js 15 app router using server components for fast data loading, Supabase for auth, database, and file storage, TypeScript throughout, and SCSS modules for styling. Integrated the Anthropic Claude API to analyze ball flight statistics and generate personalized lesson recommendations after each session upload. Deployed on Vercel.

projects.name: Muunifi
projects.description: Follow along, subscribe for exclusive access, create your own content or build your own community through muunifi's specific social financial tools.
projects.projectBio: Social platform built for financial communities
projects.projectIntro: Follow along, subscribe for exclusive access, create your own content or build your own community through Muunifi's specific social financial tools. Muunifi is your source for all the greatest alpha, financial education, and latest news on what’s breaking and up-and-coming in markets. Unfortunately, the Muunifi project was discontinued. While the site is still up, the database is no longer active.
projects.projectPurpose: Muunifi is a social platform created for people who want to get the latest and best financial advice from experts in the field. Muunifi is designed to overturn the existing socail media models and give power back to the users. Users will be able to share their own content and charge users for subscription level access to their content that is reserved for those in their inner circle.
projects.projectBuild: Muunifi was built using Next.js, React, TypeScript, MobX, Firebase, Axios, and many other great dependencies to keep the code consistent and production ready. The code is kept clean and easy to read thanks to the software design principle, 'Seperation of concerns'. This allowed the developers to separate different parts of a software system into distinct modules, each responsible for a specific set of functionalities. By doing this, each module can be developed, tested, and maintained independently, which can make the overall system more flexible, scalable, and maintainable.

projects.name: Guitlab
projects.description: Full-stack guitar learning app with interactive fretboard visualization, CAGED shape explorer, chord finder, and a drill system for locking in the neck.
projects.projectIntro: Guitlab is a full-stack guitar learning app built to make fretboard knowledge actually stick. Visualize scales and CAGED shapes across all 12 keys, identify chords with the chord finder, and drill the neck with a gamified practice system that tracks your progress over time.
projects.projectPurpose: I kept running into the same problem. I'd learn a scale position but never connect it to the rest of the neck. Static chord charts and scale diagrams weren't cutting it. I built Guitlab to be the tool I actually wanted: dynamic, interactive, and tied to real practice. Building it also pushed me into full-stack territory with auth, a Python backend, and real user data.
projects.projectBuild: Guitlab is built with React 19, TypeScript, and SCSS on the frontend, with Zustand for state management and Tonal.js for music theory logic. Audio playback uses a soundfont engine. The backend is Python, handling data and user stats. Auth and persistence are handled through Supabase. The frontend is deployed on Vercel and the backend on Render.
